s.t:
The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Retail Inside Sales Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Reverse Mortgage Loan Officers within a national consumer-direct sales environment. This role serves as the primary leader for a team of approximately 8–12 Loan Officers, with team size varying based on business needs and organizational growth.

The Team Lead is accountable for driving sales performance, improving conversion metrics, ensuring compliance adherence, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-focused service.

Through data-driven coaching, performance management, and operational partnership, the Team Lead works to maximize production while supporting employee development and organizational goals.

This position is ideal for an experienced reverse mortgage sales leader who thrives in a performance-based environment and possesses a passion for coaching, motivating, and developing top-performing sales professionals. Sales Leadership and Production
Drive team performance through consistent coaching, accountability, and sales leadership.
Lead sales discussions, brainstorming sessions, and best-practice sharing to improve individual and team performance.
Promote a results-oriented culture focused on achieving and exceeding sales objectives.
Monitor and improve lead conversion rates throughout the sales process.
Coach Loan Officers on effective borrower engagement, referral development, relationship-building, and consultative sales techniques.
Provide leadership support for unique borrower situations, escalations, and compliance-sensitive transactions when needed.
No personal loan production is expected
Coaching and Talent Development
Conduct ongoing call reviews and coaching sessions to identify strengths, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Deliver daily and weekly coaching designed to improve sales effectiveness, conversion rates, and customer experience.
Provide individualized development plans for Loan Officers at varying stages of performance.
Facilitate best-practice sharing across the team to promote continuous learning and collaboration.
Partner with the Training Department to support onboarding efforts and reinforce role-specific knowledge and application of training concepts for new hires.
Performance Management
Monitor individual and team performance metrics on an ongoing basis.
Utilize data and performance trends to diagnose performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
Conduct performance discussions, coaching conversations, and documentation as necessary.
Manage watchlists, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and disciplinary coaching processes in accordance with company policies.
Support recruiting, interviewing, and selection efforts to maintain appropriate staffing levels.
Compliance and Quality Assurance
Ensure adherence to all federal, state, investor, company, licensing, and regulatory requirements applicable to reverse mortgage lending.
Promote a culture of compliance and ethical sales practices.
Monitor quality assurance results and implement coaching strategies to address identified deficiencies.
Ensure Loan Officers properly follow established workflows, CRM requirements, call cadence expectations, lead management standards, and documentation procedures.
Maintain knowledge of industry regulations, compliance updates, and company policies.
Assist in the investigation and resolution of escalated borrower complaints, executive escalations, regulatory inquiries, and CFPB-related concerns.
May assume direct communication responsibilities with borrowers when appropriate to support complaint resolution or compliance obligations.
Pipeline and Operational Partnership
Partner closely with Processing, Operations, Underwriting, Closing, and other internal departments to facilitate efficient loan progression.
Assist with pipeline oversight and milestone management to identify and remove obstacles affecting production.
Resolve borrower, operational, and process-related escalations impacting customer experience or loan progress.
Serve as a liaison between Sales and Operations to improve communication, efficiency, and borrower outcomes.
Support company initiatives focused on workflow optimization and customer service excellence.
Reporting and Analytics
Prepare and publish daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting to team.
Analyze sales conversions, funnel metrics, contact rates, pull-through rates, and funding performance.
Utilize data to identify trends, diagnose performance opportunities, and implement action plans.
Leverage business intelligence tools and CRM reporting to support decision-making and performance management.

You will represent the front line of our company's sales and marketing efforts, playing an important role in growing the business by starting the sales process and helping set up the sales teams for success.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.
Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.
Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list.

We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand.

You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendous’ revenue growth and future success.

Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.
Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.
Use Outreach, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.
Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

2-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.
Clever and creative problem solving. We're small and emphasize output and iteration over a sales handbook set in stone.
Independence. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.
Collaboration. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.
Ability to thrive with a well-set quota. We want our goals to be fair and achievable. You should find these goals alongside your team and with your manager and use them as a benchmark for success.
Ambition. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. That’s good news for your career growth.
Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $65,000 - $70,000 plus commission.
Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.
Location
This role is remote-first and you can work wherever you want in the Americas. That said, we have a preference for SDRs based in the Austin or New York areas. There may be opportunities to train and collaborate together in person throughout the year.

FuturePlan is the nation’s largest third-party administrator (TPA) of retirement plans, partnering with advisors in all 50 states. FuturePlan delivers the best of both worlds: high-touch personalized service from local TPAs backed by the strength and security of a large national firm, Ascensus .

Our roots go back decades, with nearly 30 outstanding legacy firms now joined together to deliver unmatched levels of service, innovation and expertise to a fast-growing client base from coast to coast. The FuturePlan team includes more than 500 credentialed plan professionals, 60 actuaries, and one of the industry’s largest in-house ERISA teams.

Learn more at FuturePlan.com. Section 1: Position Summary The primary purpose of the Internal Sales Consultant is to broaden relationships among our internal and external business partner communities.

We strive to consistently support and expand critical business development activity and help maximize the growth potential of FuturePlan sales teams to help reach our firm goals.

Our vision is to deliver a uniquely better overall business experience while working proactively with our partners to deepen our value as their preferred choice in the marketplace.

We aim to propel relationships utilizing FuturePlan services by improving the overall sales experience along each step of the client and transaction lifecycle toward increased advocacy by our peers and greater brand recognition. Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Communicate and drive activity to develop new and cultivate existing partnerships within our institutional and business to business channels including advisors, wholesalers, DCIO & clients.
Work to continuously develop market knowledge and understanding to drive activity to help support the business plans of our sales consultants.
Help coordinate, support and facilitate advocacy for local industry events to expand relationship building, increase education, share knowledge, and drive new business.
Leverage FuturePlan’s investment in innovative and best in class tools, resources, training, and industry expertise to manage business opportunities and increase proposal activity to expand our brand and services among our business communities.
Support the Sales Consultant team by enhancing productivity and accessibility to positively influence overall sales effectiveness by establishing a model of proactive engagement with influencers.
To help create a team environment among the sales organization and to progress toward becoming a valuable and accessible extension of the sales consultant. Helping in proactive communication and raising awareness throughout all aspects of the sales and relationship lifecycle.
To help measure, monitor and support progress toward business development initiatives in assigned territories and assist in meeting sales goals by collaborating and developing business plans to help identify and drive critical activity.
To help create and facilitate the delivery of proposals to required parties. To help update and manage the sales lifecycle of the business pipeline. To help interpret trends, monitor campaigns, promotions and help focus activity accordingly within our advisor channels.
Help provide plan design consultation support and be able to identify areas of opportunity for business partners to close more business.
Partner with onboarding team to enhance the customer experience during the sales process at various stages including paperwork, client documentation, and plan design consultations to help efficiently bring in new plans.

Werde Teil eines Abenteuers, das stetig wächst
Decathlon in der Schweiz ist eine echte Success Story, die 2017 in Neuenburg begann. Seither haben wir jährlich rund zehn neue Filialen eröffnet und zählen heute über 50 Verkaufsstellen. Und wir denken gar nicht daran, zu bremsen! Unsere Expansion geht weiter – besonders in der Deutschschweiz. Das bedeutet für dich: Eine spannende Möglichkeit in unserer Filiale in Stans.
Warum diese Stelle deine Chance ist
Du liebst Velos, berätst gerne Kundinnen und Kunden, hast aber auch kein Problem damit, mal das Werkzeug in die Hand zu nehmen? Perfekt! Wir suchen ein Allround\-Talent für eine Mischposition aus Verkauf und du handwerkliches Geschick, technisches Verständnis und eine grosse Portion Begeisterung mitbringst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

s.h: Deine 3 grossen Vorteile auf diesem Posten
s.t:
Die perfekte Abwechslung: Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Mal stehst du auf der Verkaufsfläche und findest das Traum\-Velo für ein Kind, mal bist du in der Werkstatt und machst ein Bike startklar.
Lernen on the job: Du musst kein Profi\-Mechaniker sein. Wir zeigen dir die präzisen Handgriffe, damit du kleinere Services, Einstellungen und Reparaturen selbstständig und sicher durchführen kannst.
Volle Integration: Du bist von Tag eins an ein vollwertiges Mitglied unserer Equipe in Stans. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und gestaltest den Erfolg unserer Filiale aktiv mit.
Dieser Job ist NICHTS für dich, wenn...
Du dich nur auf eine Sache konzentrieren willst (wir suchen jemanden, der sowohl den Verkauf als auch den Service mag).
Dir der Kundenkontakt ein Graus ist und du dich lieber den ganzen Tag in der Werkstatt versteckst.
Du starre «Top\-down»\-Strukturen brauchst und darauf wartest, dass andere alle Entscheidungen für dich treffen.
Du nicht bereit bist, am Samstag zu arbeiten (denn genau dann sind unsere Sportlerinnen und Sportler am meisten auf uns angewiesen).
Dein Alltag bei uns (Deine Aufgaben)
Beratung \& Verkauf: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson in unserer Velo\-Abteilung. Du erkennst die Bedürfnisse der Kunden und verkaufst Bikes samt passendem Zubehör.
Service \& kleine Reparaturen: Du machst die Fahrräder für die Kundschaft startklar (Montage, Einstellungen von Schaltung/Bremsen, Zubehör anbringen) und führst einfache Sicherheitskontrollen durch.
Warenpräsentation: Du sorgst dafür, dass die Verkaufsfläche glänzt, die Bikes sauber präsentiert werden und die Regale immer gut gefüllt sind.
Profil: Was wir von dir erwarten
Erfahrung \& Quereinstieg: Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung im Verkauf oder einfach ein grosses Herz für den Radsport. Deine Leidenschaft und dein handwerkliches Geschick zählen!
Serviceorientierung: Du hilfst Menschen gerne und hast Freude daran, sowohl beratend als auch praktisch anzupacken.
Zuverlässigkeit: Bei der Sicherheit machen wir keine Kompromisse. Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, sauber und organisiert.
Teamgeist: Du packst ohne Zögern auch mal an der Kasse oder in anderen Abteilungen mit an, wenn Not am Mann ist.
Sportbegeisterung: Du treibst selbst aktiv Sport und kennst dein Material. Das macht deine Beratung authentisch.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch perfekt (Hauptsprache in unserer Filiale in Chur). Jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.
Was wir dir bieten
Als festes Mitglied der Decathlon\-Familie profitierst du von attraktiven Vorteilen (auf Basis eines 100%\-Pensums):
Bonus : monatlich zwischen 0 und 10%
Vorteile: 25 % Rabatt auf alle Decathlon\-Produkte und ein sportliches, motiviertes Arbeitsumfeld.
Einzigartige Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, das sportliche „Du“ auf allen Ebenen und ein hochmotiviertes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Meinung zählt
Entwicklungschancen: Viele unserer Führungskräfte haben auf der Verkaufsfläche angefangen. Wir bieten dir kontinuierliche Schulungen (z.B. zu Produktneuheiten oder Verkaufstechniken) und hervorragende interne Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten
Der Ablauf: Wie wir uns kennenlernen
Deine Bewerbung: CV \+ Antworten auf einen kurzen Fragebogen (kein Motivationsschreiben nötig!).
Das Assessment: Ein kurzer Online\-Test (AssessFirst), um dich «hinter dem Lebenslauf» kennenzulernen.
Das Gespräch: Ein unkompliziertes Kennenlernen mit dem Team\- oder Filialleiter in Chur.

**Join MSF OCG as a Philanthropy Advisor!**
**We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.**
**Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.**
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don-t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF-s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support.

This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions.

You will also contribute to the effective use of the CRM system and prospect research to strengthen the team-s fundraising approach.

* Manages a portfolio of Major donors
* Is accountable to deliver the best possible experience to MSF key donors in in order to increase their engagement.
* Qualify each Major Donor and Major Donor prospect, in close cooperation with the Prospect Researcher
* In coordination with the Team Coordinator, closely liaise with the Middle Donor manager to identify and update potential Major Donors
* Prepare and facilitate one to one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors or representatives (lawyers, wealth managers, etc.)
* Establish relations with new potential major donors, including high-potential middle givers and other prospects, including ultra-high-net-worth individuals, to secure significant future support for MSF-s work
* Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation in an attempt to show them our live saving mission and work in the projects.
* Define, propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and guidance
* Ensure that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance policy.
* Ensure that the moves management runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and steward properly.
* Keep the database up-to-date
* Liaise with Writing Officers for the preparation, including proof reading and editing, of project briefings, reports, proposals, slideshows, infographics and any other creative way of presenting MSF and its mission to private major donors
* Liaise with the Direct Marketing team to adequately leverage marketing appeals and to coordinate touch-points
*Solicitation*
* Present and defend MSF-s cases for support to individual major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Lichtenstein.
* Ensure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.
*Information and data management*
* Closely work with the System Support Team to ensure most efficient use of Customer Relationship Management Database
* Support the Team Coordinator in income forecasting and quarterly analysis of results
*Others*
* Participate in the Community of Practice for Individual Major Donors of MSF
* Work proactively on projects as needed in the Unit, upon request by her/his supervisor.
Your profile

* University degree in Business Management, Marketing, Communications, Political Science, Law, International Relations or equivalent
*Experience*
* Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in similar functions or in the fields of high-level relational skills, like public relations, wealth management or sales/marketing/communications, high-level advocacy or humanitarian project work
* Experience in using Microsoft Dynamics or other Customer Relationship Manager System: a plus
* Experience and knowledge of humanitarian aid: a plus
*Languages*
* (Swiss) German (native or equivalent),
* English
* French : a plus
* Italian: a plus
*Skills/ Technical competencies*
* Proven writing skills
* Excellent in oral public presentations
* Use of data base a plus
*Personal Abilities/Qualities*
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Rigorous and good organizational skills
* Empathic, enthusiastic, optimistic
* Result orientation
* Team spirit
* Strong commitment to MSF-s social mission and values
Terms of employment
* Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
* Open-ended contract
* Working place: Zürich
* Ideal start date: asap
* Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87-372.- to CHF 100-608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
* Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
* Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
* Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

s.h: CONSEILLER STYLE BOUTIQUE - ZEGNA AÉROPORT DE ZURICH
s.t:
Ce qui fait vous, fait Zegna
L-héritage de Zegna n-existerait pas sans les compétences uniques de chaque personne de notre équipe ; les artisans, maîtres, designers et acteurs. Chacun contribue.
En tant que Conseiller Style Boutique Zegna, vous apportez la touche humaine à l-expérience de luxe. Vous êtes notre ambassadeur, partageant à la fois notre riche héritage et nos collections, et offrant un service aussi personnel qu-exceptionnel, façonnant leur perception de notre marque et assurant notre croissance continue et notre héritage.
Ce qui compose votre journée
Plongez dans un environnement de travail pratique et intellectuel où chaque défi et opportunité vous aide à réaliser votre plein potentiel.
Vous apprendrez les histoires derrière la marque Zegna, ses produits et son savoir-faire, les utilisant pour engager authentiquement les clients en partageant notre offre et en construisant des relations durables avec eux afin qu-ils se sentent une partie précieuse du monde Zegna.
Vous et vos collègues êtes responsables d-atteindre les objectifs de vente de votre boutique, d-exécuter les plans fournis par votre responsable de boutique, ainsi que d-utiliser votre propre initiative pour suggérer des stratégies alternatives.
Vous êtes responsable de veiller à ce que l-environnement de la boutique soit toujours à la hauteur des attentes de nos clients et bien organisé. Pour cela, vous serez impliqué dans le merchandising visuel, l-emballage, la gestion du stock, l-inventaire, la caisse et les rapports.
Ce qui fait vous, fait notre équipe
Lorsque vous rejoignez Zegna, vous intégrez une équipe, travaillant ensemble pour façonner l-avenir de notre entreprise. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous avez une passion pour le style que vous emportez partout, mélangeant looks décontractés et luxueux pour s-adapter à votre style de vie actif.

Vous êtes curieux par nature, aventurier et intéressé par la technologie. Vous vous connectez à l-esprit innovant derrière la marque Zegna et savez comment le rendre pertinent et intéressant lorsque vous le partagez avec les autres.
Ce qui fait vous, fait notre héritage
Le groupe Ermenegildo Zegna est fondé sur une fière histoire d-artisanat et de qualité remontant à 1910, avec une vision de créer éthiquement les plus beaux textiles du monde. Zegna s-est depuis étendu au prêt-à-porter, devenant l-une des entreprises familiales italiennes les plus prospères et une marque mondiale de style de vie de luxe.

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.
With 70,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.
We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.
This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.
You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.
This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.
What You'll Be Doing
Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.
Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.
Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.
Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.
Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.
This Role Is For You If
You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results
You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new
You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly
You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort
You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure
You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates
You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared
Our Hiring Process
Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.
First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)
One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)
Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side
This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.
Compensation: Base Salary £26,500 - 28,000 *range depending on experience

Enhanced paid holiday: 34 days including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday
Private Medical insurance

Early bird or night owl? Our flexible hours policy allows you to structure your work for when you're most productive
Extensive tech gear kit

On-demand therapy, coaching & mental fitness via Oliva
Heavily subsidised gym membership via Gympass
Cycle to work & Workplace Nursery schemes
Flexible benefits via the thanksBen platform (Allowance is to spend on anything that makes you happy. £600 annually in year 1 - scaling year on year up to £1,980+ )

Personal L&D budget ( £500 annually in year 1 - scaling year on year up to £3000+ )
Volunteer & L&D Days: 1 paid day per quarter for either L&D or Volunteer activities
Community and Inclusion
We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.
If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.
We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

Job Description

The Strategic Business Development Advisor is responsible for developing and executing territory and account engagement strategies that expand Galvanize's presence within Enterprise and Government markets.

This role exercises independent judgment in identifying market opportunities, prioritizing target accounts, developing prospect engagement strategies, qualifying business opportunities, and advising internal stakeholders on market trends, customer needs, and pipeline development.

The position collaborates closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Strategic Account Advisors to optimize business development initiatives and improve sales effectiveness.

Strategic Pipeline Development
Develop and execute territory-specific prospecting and account engagement strategies aligned with organizational revenue objectives.
Analyze target markets, industry trends, customer initiatives, competitive activity, and organizational priorities to identify high-value business opportunities.
Determine outreach priorities and engagement approaches based on independent assessment of account potential, buying readiness, and strategic fit.
Design and adapt multi-channel engagement strategies utilizing email, phone, LinkedIn, referrals, events, and other approved business development channels.
Evaluate campaign effectiveness and modify outreach strategies to improve engagement and conversion rates.
Business Opportunity Assessment
Conduct consultative discovery conversations to evaluate organizational priorities, workforce challenges, AI initiatives, budget considerations, and strategic objectives.

Identify business risks, obstacles, and competitive considerations while recommending strategies to advance opportunities.
Develop account intelligence and strategic recommendations that enable successful engagement by Strategic Account Advisors.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Serve as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership by providing market intelligence, customer feedback, and recommendations for improving business development effectiveness.
Collaborate with Marketing to refine messaging, campaign strategy, and target audience segmentation.
Recommend improvements to business development processes, sales workflows, qualification methodology, and CRM utilization.
Participate in planning discussions regarding territory development, market expansion, and pipeline forecasting.
Pipeline Management & Business Analysis
Maintain responsibility for the quality, health, and strategic direction of assigned business development pipeline.
Analyze pipeline performance, conversion metrics, and engagement effectiveness to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare reports and communicate market observations, business risks, opportunity forecasts, and pipeline insights to leadership.
Ensure CRM records accurately reflect strategic account information, customer needs, opportunity status, and recommended actions.

3+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, consultative sales, recruiting, or a related client-facing business role.

Experience analyzing customer organizations and developing strategic engagement plans.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to executive and senior leadership audiences.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Understanding of AI adoption, workforce transformation, and organizational change initiatives.
Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success functions.
